plugins.name: n360-engineering
plugins.description: Zero-defect engineering standard for Claude Code. Session discipline, TDD, investigation protocol, circuit breakers, security baselines, performance targets, rollback playbooks, and observability. Built for teams where code quality is non-negotiable.

skills.name: large-feature
skills.description: Use when a feature touches 5+ files, involves multiple layers (API + DB + frontend), or will take more than one session to complete. Enforces structured decomposition with design-first, task breakdown, review gates, and integration verification. Prevents context drift during long implementation sessions.
skills.description_zh: 对涉及至少 5 个文件、多层 API/数据库/前端或跨会话的大功能，采用设计优先、任务分解、评审关卡及集成验证，减少长时间实施中的上下文偏移。

skills.name: operating-standard
skills.description: Use at every session start and throughout all development work. This is the core engineering standard — it governs session start/end procedures, code quality rules, investigation protocol, circuit breakers, security baselines, performance targets, commit format, rollback playbooks, and observability requirements. Activates automatically on session start.
skills.description_zh: 提供 n360 核心工程规范，规定会话开始结束、代码质量、调查、熔断、安全基线、性能目标、提交格式、回滚与可观测性要求；原说明将其用于开发全程。

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Use when implementing any new feature, endpoint, service method, or critical flow. Enforces strict RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycles where tests must fail before implementation exists. Does NOT trigger for quick bug fixes, config changes, documentation, single-line patches, or UI tweaks with no logic.
headings: Red Flags — Start Over If Any Occur
skills.description_zh: 对新功能、端点、服务方法和关键流程采用严格的测试失败、实现通过、重构循环，要求测试先于实现失败；原说明排除简单缺陷修复、配置文档、单行修改及无逻辑 UI 调整。
